## Behavior change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and linked issue.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results, including pending or skipped tests. Add screenshots for visual changes.

## Deployment and data impact

Describe migrations, configuration, ABI, deployment, and custody or authorization changes. State any required follow-up.

- [ ] No real credentials, private keys, personal records, or local environment files are included.
- [ ] Current status and architecture documentation match the behavior.
- [ ] Security-sensitive cases have relevant regression coverage.

## Phone experience (for UI changes)

- [ ] Essential tasks work on phones, including administration where affected.
- [ ] Screenshots cover 360/390px and desktop when responsive behavior changes.
- [ ] No page overflow at 320px, hidden actions, or keyboard/safe-area obstruction.
- [ ] Copy is short and concrete; payment terms, amounts, and errors remain visible.
- [ ] Loading, empty, error, retry, and wallet-return states are checked where affected.

Record actual device/browser/wallet results and any untested environments. Follow [mobile acceptance](../docs/MOBILE_ACCEPTANCE.md). Separate implemented changes from target specifications and historical evidence.
